baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence qama / abdu Allahi / yaduhu sets an upright, intentional servant at the center of libadan, a mass directed upon him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bodily rising and resolved undertaking establish a vertical center; worshipful servanthood and a vocal call that draws near generate an almost completed crowd whose members compact like felt and pile over one another.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily rising supplies the scene's vertical human center.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter make the standing an intentional act, not mere posture.
Worship and submissive obedience identify the undertaking as devotional service.
Calling that draws near by speech supplies the attraction toward the standing caller.
Near-performance keeps the crowd's compact state at the threshold of completion.
Material compacted layer over layer supplies the felt-like loss of gaps and individual edges.
Gathered abundance piled person over person converts the material image into a human or jinn crowd.

changed_reading.before: A servant stood calling God while they nearly crowded him.
changed_reading.after: Resolved worship forms an upright center, and the call nearly draws the surrounding plurality into a felted, person-over-person convergence upon the caller.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kadu yakununa alayhi libadan describes a not-yet-completed collective state explicitly oriented upon the standing servant.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant k-w-d branch marks imminence, while its packet-supplied non-dominant k-y-d mapping keeps plotting live; q-w-m contributes facing off and l-b-d turns separate agents into one compact layer. The result is an incipient oppositional coalition rather than density alone.

activation_trace.role: Opposition and facing off color the standing as a contested stance.
Nearly doing an act makes the hostile configuration imminent but incomplete.
The split-mapped plotting and stratagem image supplies a tentative shared hostile intention.
Coming into temporal occurrence models the coalition as a state in formation.
Layer-over-layer compaction gives the coalition physical and social coherence.

changed_reading.before: They almost became a crowd upon him.
changed_reading.after: They almost cohered into a layered coalition facing the servant; the plotting color is exploratory, and kadu preserves the coalition as incipient rather than accomplished.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yaduhu and alayhi libadan can join vocal attraction to a mass that takes position and remains close to the caller.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call draws agents near, becoming supplies a positioned state, and l-b-d supplies staying put and adhesion. The same density can therefore describe tenacious attendance rather than impact or attack.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near supplies the centripetal movement toward the servant.
Place and position turn becoming into the taking up of a location around him.
Staying put and sticking supplies persistent, close attendance.

changed_reading.before: The plural nearly presses down on the servant.
changed_reading.after: The call nearly fixes the plural into an adherent assembly that takes position and will not disperse from around him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening chain turns proximity into reception: a cohort listens with possible understanding and compliance, encounters recitation, and q-r-' also supplies gathering. Applied to focus d-w and l-b-d, the dense mass can be an audience drawn into attendance by heard recitation rather than an assailing mob.

activation_trace.role: The focus call literally draws listeners near and anchors the auditory mechanism.
The focus crowd piled together supplies the resulting dense audience.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes the convergence responsive rather than merely acoustic.
A mobilized, supporting cohort supplies a plural audience capable of converging as a group.
Reading and recitation identify the vocal object around which the hearers gather.
Gathering and collection reinforce recitation as a social collecting force.

structural_cues: 72:1 sequences a jinn cohort's listening before its report of hearing a recitation; 72:2 immediately records a guidance response.
The focus call and the opening act of listening form complementary speaking and receiving poles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a listening cohort, recitation, comprehension, and the focus crowd; I infer that the later plural may converge as hearers. A hostile or merely curious crowd remains materially possible.

changed_reading.before: Persistent attendance is spatially possible but has no stated motive.
changed_reading.after: The almost-piled mass becomes a receptive listening assembly collected by recitation, with threat retained only as a competing possibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The r-h-q inventory includes the concrete social image of many guests or questioners repeatedly coming upon a man. Coupled with the focus call that attracts and l-b-d that piles, alayhi can carry demand-pressure: seekers accumulate upon the servant until access itself becomes a burden.

activation_trace.role: Calling that draws near supplies the invitation or attraction producing approach.
People piled together give physical density to accumulated social demands.
Many guests and questioners thronging a man supplies the literal social-load image and makes the crowd a burden of access.

structural_cues: R-h-q appears as an increased burden in 72:6 and as a burden the believer need not fear in 72:13.
The focus preposition alayhi permits the converging plurality to be felt as a load borne by the servant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies social thronging under r-h-q and a piled focus crowd; I infer that attraction to the call produces burdensome access and questioning. Coercive oppression or eager listening may explain the same density instead.

changed_reading.before: The mass is a generic crowd, usually imagined as hostile or physically crushing.
changed_reading.after: The mass can be the pressure of guests, seekers, or questioners accumulating upon an accessible caller until their approach becomes load-like.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly builds dense monitored space: the sky is filled and guarded, a watcher awaits the listener, watchers stand around the messenger, and the close invokes encompassing preservation. This spatial system can recast libadan alayhi as an almost closed cordon of watch or protection rather than a crowd necessarily striking him.

activation_trace.role: Layer-over-layer compaction supplies the density of an almost closed perimeter.
Fullness equal to a container supplies a space with no unoccupied approach.
Guarding and preservation assign surveillance or protective function to the density.
Watching and guarding place a monitored cordon specifically around the messenger's route.
Preserving enclosure turns surrounding from pressure alone into possible protection.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 pairs a filled guarded sky with a watcher stationed for attempted listening.
72:27 places watch before and behind a chosen messenger, and 72:28 closes with encompassing knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated filled, guarded, watched, and encompassed spaces; I project that spatial function onto the focus mass. The plural may instead be eager hearers or opponents, so protection cannot be asserted as identity.

changed_reading.before: Libadan alayhi is a mob physically piling onto the servant.
changed_reading.after: The dense plurality may form an almost closed watching or protective perimeter upon and around the messenger, while its exact allegiance remains unresolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first supplies plural paths and differentiated parties, including a layer-over-layer image, then selects straightness on the singular path. Against focus qama and libad, the scene becomes social geometry: one resolved upright line is surrounded by plural, stratified alignments compressing toward it.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily standing supplies the single vertical axis.
Felt-like layers supply the compressed stratification around that axis.
Layer above layer converts plural paths into a stratified social field.
Differentiated paths and parties preserve internal plurality inside the apparent mass.
Straightness and evenness sharpen the focus standing into a committed alignment.

structural_cues: 72:11 describes plural paths as mutually differentiated, whereas 72:16 speaks of remaining straight on the singular path.
The focus juxtaposes one standing servant with a plural predicate of layered density.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural differentiated paths, stratification, straightness, and the focus's upright-versus-layered contrast; I infer a social-topological diagram. A literal crowd scene remains the less mediated reading.

changed_reading.before: One standing body is surrounded by an undifferentiated crowd.
changed_reading.after: The upright servant embodies a straight committed line while distinct paths and parties nearly compress into layers around and against that line.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate frame makes the focus call exclusive divine invocation in a worship setting, then limits the speaker's agency to conveying messages. Qama is therefore public discharge of servant-messenger duty; the dense response does not turn the caller into a personal sovereign, source of guidance, or object of worship.

activation_trace.role: Resolved undertaking anchors the servant's active discharge of duty.
Worshipful obedience fixes his status as servant rather than owner of the crowd's response.
The focus call supplies the vocal act whose addressee and limits the context clarifies.
A place of prostration supplies the immediate cultic setting for exclusive invocation.
The prohibition on calling alongside God gives the same speech-attraction branch an exclusivity boundary.
The first-person restatement identifies the call as directed only to the speaker's Lord.
Conveying a message bounds the servant's causal role to transmission.
Messenger and message identify the standing act as entrusted communication rather than personal dominion.

structural_cues: 72:18 prohibits calling anyone with God, and 72:20 restates: I call only my Lord.
72:21-23 deny personal control over harm or guidance and retain only delivery from God and His messages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a worship setting, exclusive call, denied personal power, and delivery duty; I infer that the crowd is a response to public mission rather than evidence of the servant's own authority. Its receptive or hostile valence remains open.

changed_reading.before: A charismatic devotional caller stands at the center of a dense response.
changed_reading.after: A servant publicly performs exclusive invocation and entrusted delivery; however dense the response becomes, it confers no personal sovereignty or power to guide.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant d-a-a split mapping and transfers vessel mechanics into a social scene. It remains anchored in focus yaduhu and libadan, whose cited images supply agitation-to-fullness and felt-like compaction. Render it only as a material analogy for the call's social effect, never as the lexical gloss of yaduhu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus itself places the split-mapped call immediately before a plurality becoming libadan.

activation_trace.role: Agitating a vessel until it fills supplies an analogical acoustic-to-material packing action.
Coming into occurrence mediates the transition from separate hearers to a packed state.
Material felted layer over layer supplies the packed result of the analogy.

changed_reading.before: The call merely coincides with the crowd's formation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, vocal action agitates a social vessel until separate bodies nearly pack into felt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a posture contrast across the immediate boundary: prostrating or bowed space, one standing servant, and a mass sticking low. It remains anchored in focus qama and libadan and in the adjacent worship cue. Render it as possible congregational staging only, explicitly avoiding any suggestion that the crowd worships the servant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus qama supplies the upright figure, while focus libadan can supply a close mass that stays put or adheres low.

activation_trace.role: Bodily uprightness supplies the standing worship leader or caller.
Sticking to the ground and staying put supplies a close, lowered assembly.
Bowing and lowering the head activate a congregational posture contrast immediately before the focus.

changed_reading.before: The mass climbs over or bears down on the standing servant.
changed_reading.after: The image may instead stage one upright caller amid a dense lowered assembly remaining close in worship directed to God.

strongest_changes: The opening listening-recitation sequence changes an unmarked crowd into a plausible receptive audience collected by the call.
The 72:18-23 frame changes standing and calling into exclusive invocation plus bounded messenger duty, denying that crowd response grants personal power.
Repeated filled, guarded, watched, and encompassed spaces keep an exploratory cordon reading alive alongside hostile and receptive crowds.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports unusually strong spatial reversibility: one upright servant can be mobbed, attended, socially burdened, or cordoned by the same felt-like plurality, while the context changes motive and function without dissolving the qama-versus-libad geometry.
remaining_uncertainties: The plural antecedent and the directional force of alayhi do not settle whether the mass is receptive, hostile, burdensome, or protective.
The plotting, vessel-compaction, and congregational-posture readings depend on split-root or cross-domain activation and must remain explicitly exploratory.
The path-layer model is structurally coherent but more mediated than the literal crowd and listening-audience readings.
